metadata.title: fix(gateway): preserve per-resource visibility on gateway refresh
metadata.author: gandhipratik203

description:
## Related Issue

Closes #3524

## Summary

`_update_or_create_resources()` forced `gateway.visibility` on every gateway refresh, silently overwriting resource-specific visibility overrides that were correctly set during initial registration via `register_gateway()`.

<details>
<summary>Change details</summary>

**The inconsistency**

| Path | Visibility logic | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `register_gateway()` (line 961) | `getattr(r, "visibility", None) or visibility` | Respects per-resource override ✅ |
| `_update_or_create_resources()` — update (line 4227) | `gateway.visibility` | Overwrites override ❌ |
| `_update_or_create_resources()` — create (line 4240) | `gateway.visibility` | Ignores override ❌ |

**Fix**

Both the update and create paths in `_update_or_create_resources()` now use:

```python
getattr(resource, "visibility", None) or gateway.visibility
```

matching the existing behaviour in `register_gateway()`. When a resource carries no visibility override, gateway visibility is used as before.

**Tests**

Updated existing tests to explicitly set `resource.visibility = None` where gateway visibility should win. Added two regression tests:
- Per-resource visibility is preserved on update when `update_visibility=True`
- Per-resource visibility is used on create in `_update_or_create_resources()`

</details>

---

## Scope

| Requirement | Status |
|---|---|
| `_update_or_create_resources()` update path respects per-resource visibility | ✅ |
| `_update_or_create_resources()` create path respects per-resource visibility | ✅ |
| Consistent with `register_gateway()` behaviour | ✅ |
| Regression tests added | ✅ |

---

## 🔬 Steps to Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service_extended.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service_helpers.py -v
```

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] Tests added/updated for changes
- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

reviews.body: Approved. The original resource visibility fix is correct and has been extended to cover the full surface: pre-propagation guard, all three entity types (resources, tools, prompts), both update and create paths, schema defaults, and input validation. Verified end-to-end on Docker with PostgreSQL.

commits.message:
fix(gateway): preserve per-resource visibility on gateway refresh

_update_or_create_resources() previously forced gateway.visibility on
every refresh, silently overwriting resource-specific visibility overrides
set during initial registration via register_gateway().

Both the update and create paths now use:
  getattr(resource, "visibility", None) or gateway.visibility

matching the existing behaviour in register_gateway() (line 961).

Updated existing tests to explicitly set resource.visibility = None where
gateway visibility should win, and added two regression tests:
- resource-specific visibility is preserved on update (update_visibility=True)
- resource-specific visibility is used on create in _update_or_create_resources

Closes #3524

Signed-off-by: Pratik Gandhi <gandhipratik203@gmail.com>
commits.author: Pratik Gandhi

commits.message:
fix(schemas): set ResourceCreate.visibility default to None for correct fallback

ResourceCreate.visibility defaulted to "public", which caused the
getattr(resource, "visibility", None) or gateway.visibility pattern
to always evaluate to "public" for MCP-discovered resources—never
falling through to gateway.visibility. This was a security regression:
resources on team/private gateways would silently get public visibility.

Change the default to None so the or-fallback works correctly everywhere:
- _update_or_create_resources() create & update paths
- register_gateway() per-resource visibility logic (pre-existing fix)

Also update resource_service.register_resource() to handle the None
default with an explicit or "public" fallback.

Add regression test using actual ResourceCreate (not MagicMock) to
verify MCP-discovered resources inherit gateway visibility.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(gateway): preserve per-resource visibility during pre-propagation and validate values

Address three findings from Codex review:

1. (Major) Pre-propagation at line 1913 blindly set all linked resources
   to the new gateway visibility, destroying per-resource overrides before
   _update_or_create_resources() could preserve them. Now captures the old
   gateway visibility and only propagates to items that inherited it;
   per-item overrides are preserved.

2. (Minor) Change detection in _update_or_create_resources compared
   existing_resource.visibility against gateway.visibility instead of the
   effective target visibility. Fixed to use the same getattr-or-fallback
   expression used in the assignment.

3. (Minor) ResourceCreate accepted arbitrary visibility strings with no
   validation. Added @field_validator("visibility") matching the pattern
   already used in ServerCreate, PromptCreate, and A2AAgentCreate.

Tests: added test_update_gateway_visibility_preserves_per_resource_overrides
covering the full update_gateway flow with a mix of inherited and overridden
resource visibility.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(gateway): only update resource visibility from explicit upstream values

When _update_or_create_resources processes existing resources, only update
visibility if the upstream resource explicitly sets one (not None). When
the upstream has no visibility (typical for MCP-discovered resources),
preserve the existing DB value — the pre-propagation in update_gateway
already handles updating inherited resources.

Previously, the helper fell back to gateway.visibility when upstream was
None, which overwrote per-resource overrides that the pre-propagation
had correctly preserved.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(gateway): extend per-item visibility preservation to tools and prompts

Apply the same upstream_visibility guard to _update_or_create_tools and
_update_or_create_prompts: only update visibility when the upstream object
explicitly sets one. MCP-discovered tools/prompts carry no visibility, so
the helpers now preserve existing DB values — the pre-propagation in
update_gateway already handles updating inherited items.

Also change ToolCreate.visibility and PromptCreate.visibility defaults
from "public" to None (matching ResourceCreate), and add visibility
validators to both schemas. Update tool_service and prompt_service
fallback lines to handle None with explicit or "public" fallback.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(schemas): add full docstrings to ToolCreate and PromptCreate visibility validators

flake8 DAR requires Args, Returns, and Raises sections in docstrings.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(gateway): respect per-item visibility on tool and prompt create paths

The create paths in _create_db_tool() and _update_or_create_prompts()
still hardcoded gateway.visibility for new items. Now use the same
getattr(item, "visibility", None) or gateway.visibility pattern already
used for resources, so explicit upstream visibility is honored.

Also set visibility=None on all MagicMock server objects in tests to
correctly simulate MCP-discovered items without per-item visibility.
Added test_create_db_tool_respects_explicit_tool_visibility to cover
the explicit override path.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
chore: bump max-bool-expr from 6 to 7 in ruff config

The visibility change detection in _update_or_create_resources uses
4 field comparisons + 1 compound visibility check (3 and-chained
sub-expressions), totaling 7 boolean ops. Raise the limit by 1.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test: cover visibility validator rejection and explicit upstream tool/prompt updates

Add tests for the 5 uncovered lines:
- schemas.py:418,1637,2208: parametrized test that ToolCreate, ResourceCreate,
  and PromptCreate all reject invalid visibility strings with ValueError
- gateway_service.py:4163: test that explicit upstream tool visibility is
  applied to existing tools when update_visibility=True
- gateway_service.py:4344: test that explicit upstream prompt visibility is
  applied to existing prompts when update_visibility=True

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
